mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal potassium secretion in the collecting duct by blocking epithelial sodium channels, leading to hyperkalemia risk, especially in patients with renal impairment or concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels before and during trimethoprim therapy; avoid concurrent potassium supplementation unless necessary; use caution in renal dysfunction and consider alternative antibiotics if baseline potassium is elevated.
